criteria.help: Write each criterion as a yes-or-no question. A model answers each one yes, no or unclear. A no on a must-have makes the model vote Exclude, and an unclear makes it vote Maybe. A nice-to-have never makes a model vote Exclude. Guidance under a question says what counts. A reviewer opens it with "Guidance" under the question on Screen, and a model reads it with the question. The words you mark for a criterion are marked in each abstract while a person votes.

decided.help: A paper is settled when its votes agree as the rule asks. When they don't, it is in conflict, and one person settles it.
decided.factEveryone: Everyone covers people who join later
decided.eachHelp: Every model reads every paper that is open when it joins. This sets how many people vote on each one. The papers are shared out so each person reads about the same number. A set number stays the same as people join. Everyone means every person on the screening, now and later.
decided.onePerson: One person, since the first vote decides
decided.modelVotesVote: When the models' votes count like a person's, each is one reviewer's vote, and a paper is settled on the people's and the models' votes together. Where the models alone would outvote every person on it, the paper is in conflict instead.
decided.modelVotesAdvice: When they are advice only, a paper a person has is settled on the people's votes alone, and the models' votes show beside theirs.
decided.modelVotesNever: Either way, a paper no person is given is settled on the models' votes. Under First vote decides, the models' votes are advice on any paper a person has.
decided.modelsUnderOne: Advice on papers a person has
decided.oneVote: Every reviewer given a paper has one vote.
decided.conflictsHelp: This person sees every vote on the paper, and what they pick is its result.
decided.noConflicts: No conflicts to settle under this rule
decided.seeingHelp: After they vote keeps a reviewer from being swayed. Each sees the other votes on a paper once they have voted on it, or once it is settled. Anyone who doesn't vote on a paper sees its votes at any time.
decided.withVotes: {count, plural, one {With # vote on a paper, for example} other {With # votes on a paper, for example}}
decided.addReviewer: Add a reviewer to see how a paper is settled.
decided.modelSettles: A model's vote settles only the papers no person is given. On the others, the first person's vote decides.
decided.oneVoteEach: One vote settles each paper, so there is no conflict to settle

goesHelp: Papers whose result is Included are added to the collection you pick, in your library or in an Evidence Community, with the stars from Scoring. Nowhere keeps them in the screening only.
